title: From SU to city government: How Jill Ferguson's 25 years in grants and community work shaped her new role leading neighborhood development
summary: Mayor Sharon F. Owens has appointed Jill Ferguson as director of neighborhood grants in the Department of Neighborhood and Business Development. Ferguson brings 25 years of experience in grants administration and community engagement from her previous role at Syracuse University, positioning her to lead the city's neighborhood development grant programs.
